name: io.github.shakerg/model-mcp
title: Local Model Discovery
description: Discovers models exposed by local Ollama, LM Studio, and OpenAI-compatible runtimes.

environmentVariables.name: MODEL_MCP_ENDPOINTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated local model endpoint base URLs.

environmentVariables.name: MODEL_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each model endpoint request.

environmentVariables.name: MODEL_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTE
environmentVariables.description: Allow configured model endpoints outside the local machine.
